note: The root key uses the river name’s own consonants.
summary: Hiddekel is the Hebrew name of the Tigris. Genesis names it as the third river of Eden and describes it as flowing east of Asshur.

senses.definition: The river that Genesis identifies as the third of Eden’s four rivers.

evidence.note: חִדֶּקֶל supplies the name in “the name of the third river.” The following clause describes its course east of Asshur.
